blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Style transfer aims to render target content in the style of a reference image, but existing methods often suffer from content leakage, where objects, layouts, or semantics from the style reference appear in the generated output. Although prior data-driven and training-free methods can reduce leakage, they often face a leakage-degradation dilemma: stronger content suppression may weaken style fidelity, while richer style preservation may reintroduce unwanted reference content. We identify this dilemma across the full style-transfer pipeline, including feature separation, feature-space grounding, and diffusion generation. To address these issues, we propose CLeaR, a training-free framework for content-leakage-resistant style transfer. CLeaR first uses Orthogonal Subspace Projection to define content-reduced style targets in each vision foundation model (VFM) feature space. It then performs Ensemble Inversion, which optimizes a shared pixel-space style anchor satisfying style constraints across multiple VFMs. Finally, Energy-Guided Calibration maintains style alignment during diffusion sampling by steering the denoising trajectory toward the ensemble-defined style manifold. We further provide a theoretical analysis showing that the style-anchor estimation error decreases with the number of VFMs. Experiments on StyleBench demonstrate that CLeaR improves style alignment, reduces content leakage, and achieves better LLM-as-Judge evaluation compared with existing methods. The code is available at https://github.com/0606zt/CLeaR .
blocks.zh: 样式传输旨在使目标内容具有参考图像的样式,但现有方法往往受到内容渗漏的影响,在生成的输出中会出现样式引用的对象,布局,或语义. 虽然以往的数据驱动和无培训方法可以减少渗漏,但它们往往面临渗漏-降解的两难境地:强化内容抑制可能会削弱风格忠贞性,而更丰富的风格保存可能会重新引入不想要的参考内容. 我们查明了整个风格转让管道的这种两难境地,包括特征分离、特征空间地面定位和传播生成。 为了解决这些问题,我们提出CLeaR,一个无培训的框架,用于进行耐漏内容的样式转让. CLeaR首先使用Orthogonal Subspace Projection来定义每个视觉基础模型(VFM)中的内容减少样式目标特征空间. 然后它进行Ensemble Inversion,它优化了共享像素-空间风格主锚,满足多个VFM的风格限制. 最后,能源导向校准在扩散取样期间通过引导调试轨迹向综艺界定的样式多面进行样式调整。 我们进一步提供了理论分析,显示样式-定点估计误差随着VFM数量减少. 关于Style Bench的实验表明,CLeaR改进了样式对齐,减少了内容泄漏,比起现有方法,实现了更好的LLM-as-Judge评价. 该代码可在https://github.com/0606zt/CleaR上查阅. 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Given a style reference image and a target content condition, style transfer (ST) aims to render the target content in the reference style. Since early neural style transfer, this task has been closely tied to content-style (C-S) separation Gatys et al. (2015) . With diffusion models becoming the dominant backbone for image generation Rombach et al. (2022) ; Podell et al. (2024) , ST is increasingly formulated as conditional generation Wang et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2023b) ; Chung et al. (2024) ; Hertz et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2024) . However, incomplete C-S disentanglement can cause content leakage, where objects, layouts, or semantics from the style reference appear in the output Zhu et al. (2025) ; Rout et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2024) , reducing quality and user control.
blocks.zh: 由于样式参考图像和目标内容条件,样式传输(ST)旨在使目标内容成为参考样式. 自早期神经风格转移以来,这一任务一直与内容风格(C-S)分离Gatys等人(2015年)紧密相连. 随着扩散模型成为图像生成Rombach等人(2022年);Podell等人(2024年),ST逐渐形成为有条件的生成者Wang等人(2023年);Zhang等人(2023年b); Chung等人(2024年);Hertz等人(2024年);Wang等人(2024年)。 然而,不完全的C-S解析可能导致内容渗漏,其中来自风格参考的对象,布局,或语义出现在输出Zhu等人(2025年);Rout等人(2025年);Wang等人(2024年),降低了质量和用户控制.

blocks.en: To mitigate content leakage, existing methods commonly use visual representations from pretrained or learned encoders to define a style condition that is later injected into a diffusion generator. Data-driven methods train style-aware encoders, disentanglement modules, adapters, or projection layers on paired or curated stylization data Gao et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025a) ; Zhang et al. (2024) ; Sohn et al. (2023) ; Liu et al. (2023) ; Ma et al. (2025) ; Qi et al. (2024) ; Xing et al. (2025) . Although effective in specific settings, they require additional training and are often constrained by the training distribution. Training-free methods instead manipulate pretrained VFM or diffusion features directly, such as subtracting content-related text features from image features Wang et al. (2024) , masking feature dimensions, shuffling spatial tokens, modifying attention keys and values, or guiding the denoising trajectory with reference-based objectives Zhu et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025b) ; Roy et al. (2025) ; Chung et al. (2024) ; Hertz et al. (2024) ; Rout et al. (2025) . Despite these differences, both paradigms typically define style within a particular feature space and rely on the diffusion model to generate the final image from the resulting edited or guided condition.
blocks.zh: 为了减少内容泄漏,现有方法通常使用预先训练或学习过的编码器的视觉表示来定义一种样式条件,这种条件后来注入扩散生成器. 数据驱动方法 培训风格感知编码器,分解模块,适配器,或投影层 在对称或编解的阶梯化数据Gao等人(2025);Wang等人(2025a); 张等人(2024年);索恩等人(2023年);刘等人(2023年);马等人(2025年);齐等人(2024年);邢等人(2025年). 虽然在特定情况下是有效的,但它们需要更多的培训,并经常受到培训分配的限制。 无训练方法代替直接操纵预先训练的VFM或扩散特性,如从图像特性Wang et al中减去内容相关的文字特性. (2024),遮盖特征维度,挥动空间符号,修改关注键和值,或以参考目标引导调试轨迹. Zhu等人(2025年);Wang等人(2025年b);Roy等人(2025年);Chung等人(2024年);Hertz等人(2024年);Rout等人(2025年)。 尽管存在这些差异,两种范式一般都定义特定特征空间内的风格,并依靠扩散模型从由此产生的编辑或引导条件生成最终图像.

blocks.en: Although these methods can reduce content leakage in some cases, they often lack stable control over the boundary between content removal and style preservation. As a result, existing methods tend to fail on different sides of the same dilemma Rout et al. (2025) : methods that preserve rich style cues may also retain unwanted reference content, whereas methods that suppress reference content more strongly may remove important stylistic details. We refer to this as the leakage-degradation dilemma.
blocks.zh: 虽然这些方法在某些情况下可以减少内容渗漏,但往往缺乏对内容去除和风格保存之间界限的稳定控制. 因此,现有方法往往在同一困境Rout et al.(2025)的不同方面都失败:保留丰富风格提示的方法也可能保留不想要的参考内容,而更强烈压制参考内容的方法可能会消除重要的风格细节. 我们将此称为渗漏降解困境。

blocks.en: This dilemma is not caused by a single isolated step. It arises throughout the style-transfer pipeline, from separating C-S features, to grounding the style signal in a representation space, to injecting that signal during diffusion generation.
blocks.zh: 这种两难处境并不是孤立的一步造成的。 它在整个风格转换管道中产生,从分离C-S特征,到将风格信号固定在代表空间,到在扩散生成过程中注入该信号.

blocks.en: The first source is the feature separation stage , where content-related and style-related components are separated within a reference representation. Existing operations such as subtraction, masking, patch manipulation, or attention editing can reduce content signals, but are mostly heuristic and may either leave residual content or discard style information correlated with content. To address this issue, we introduce Orthogonal Subspace Projection (OSP), which defines the style target geometrically in each VFM feature space. Given a content proxy, it removes the component of the reference feature aligned with the content direction and retains the orthogonal residual as the style feature.
blocks.zh: 第一个来源是特征分离阶段. 其中内容相关和风格相关组件在一个参考代表中分离. 现有的操作,如减码,遮掩,补丁操纵,或注意编辑等,可以减少内容信号,但大多是高压的,可能留下与内容相关的剩余内容或丢弃样式信息. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了Orthogonal Subspace Projection(OSP),它在每个VFM特征空间中以几何方式定义了样式目标. 由于内容代理,它删除了与内容方向一致的引用特性的组件,并保留正交残基作为样式特性.

blocks.en: The second source is the feature-space grounding stage , where the extracted style signal is grounded in a particular representation space. Most existing methods rely on a single VFM feature space or a single learned representation, which is fragile because different VFMs encode style and content differently Radford et al. (2021) ; Siméoni et al. (2025) ; Kar et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2023a) . Directly aligning multiple VFM spaces is impractical because their dimensions, metrics, and semantic structures differ, while learning cross-space projectors would add training cost and risk domain overfitting. Instead, we make use of a simpler and more general observation: image pixel space provides a shared domain associated with all VFM feature spaces. This allows heterogeneous style constraints to be combined by optimizing an image itself, rather than by aligning feature spaces directly. Based on this idea, we introduce Ensemble Inversion (EI), which optimizes a learnable image tensor into a shared style anchor whose features satisfy the model-specific style constraints across all VFM branches.
blocks.zh: 第二个来源是地物-空间定位阶段,其中提取的样式信号被固定在一个特定的表示空间. 大多数现有方法都依赖于单一的VFM特征空间或单一的学习表现,这很脆弱,因为不同的VFM编码样式和内容不同Radford等人(2021年);Siméoni等人(2025年);Kar等人(2024年);Zhang等人(2023年a). 直接对齐多个VFM空间是不切实际的,因为其尺寸,度量,语义结构不同,而学习跨空间投影仪会增加培训成本和风险域过于匹配. 相反,我们利用了一个更简单,更泛泛的观察:图像像素空间提供了一个与所有VFM特征空间相关的共享域. 这样就可以通过优化一个图像本身,而不是通过直接对齐特征空间,来组合各种风格限制. 基于这一想法,我们引入了Ensemble Inversion(EI),它优化了可学习的图像显示器,形成一个共享的样式主锚,其特征满足了所有VFM分支中模式特有的样式限制.

blocks.en: The third source is the diffusion generation stage , where the extracted style condition is injected into the generative process. Standard condition injectors such as IP-Adapter Ye et al. (2023) are trained on ordinary image-text pairs rather than on content-reduced style anchors, so the denoising trajectory may drift from the intended style or reintroduce leaked content. To address this issue, we introduce Energy-Guided Calibration (EGC), a test-time guidance mechanism inspired by prior diffusion guidance methods Yu et al. (2023) ; Bansal et al. (2023) . At selected denoising steps, it computes an ensemble feature-alignment energy between the current decoded image and the target style representation, and uses its gradient to calibrate the latent update toward the VFM-defined style manifold.
blocks.zh: 第三个来源是扩散生成阶段,其中提取的样式条件注入基因过程. IP-Adapter Ye等人(2023年)等标准条件注入器在普通的图像文本配对上而不是在内容减少的样式锚上接受训练,因此去诺的轨迹可能从预定的样式漂移,或者重新引入泄露的内容. 为了解决这一问题,我们采用了“能源指导校准”这一试验时间指导机制,其灵感来自先前的传播指导方法Yu等人(2023年);Bansal等人(2023年)。 在选定的去诺化步骤中,它计算了当前解码图像与目标样式代表之间的共聚特征对齐能量,并使用它的梯度来校准向VFM自定义样式多面的潜伏更新.

blocks.en: In summary, we introduce CLeaR ( C ontent Lea kage R esistant), a training-free framework for C-S disentangled style transfer. CLeaR defines content-reduced style targets through Orthogonal Subspace Projection, reconciles heterogeneous VFM targets through Ensemble Inversion, and maintains style alignment through Energy-Guided Calibration. Together, these components reduce content leakage at both the representation-extraction stage and the generation stage.
blocks.zh: 简言之,我们引入了CLeaR(C ontent Lea kage R esistant),这是C-S分离风格传输的无培训框架. CLeaR通过Orthogonal Subspace Projection定义了内容减少的样式目标,通过Ensemble Inversion调和了各种VFM目标,并通过Energy-Guided校正维持样式对齐. 这些组件加在一起减少了在表示-提取阶段和生成阶段的内容渗漏。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose CLeaR, a training-free framework that extracts a shared pixel-space style anchor via Orthogonal Subspace Projection and Ensemble Inversion, and maintains style alignment through Energy-Guided Calibration. • We provide a theoretical analysis showing that the style-anchor estimation error decreases with the number of VFMs under limited cross-model dependence. • Experiments on StyleBench Gao et al. (2025) show improvements in style alignment, content leakage metrics, and LLM-as-Judge evaluation.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们提出CLeaR,一个无训练框架,通过Orthogonal Subspace Projection和Ensemble Inversion提取一个共享的像素-空间风格主锚,并通过Energy-Guided 校正来保持风格对齐. ^ 我们提供的理论分析显示,在有限的跨模型依赖性下,样式-锁定估计误差随着VFM的数量减少. • 关于Style Bench Gao等人(2025年)的实验显示,样式一致、内容泄漏度量表和LLM-as-Judge评价都有改进。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Gatys et al. Gatys et al. (2015) formalized style transfer by optimizing deep feature statistics. With diffusion models Rombach et al. (2022) ; Podell et al. (2024) and conditioning adapters Ye et al. (2023) , style transfer has increasingly become a conditional generation task, where the central challenge is still C-S separation Wang et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 盖提斯等人. Gattys等人(2015年)通过优化深层特征统计,将风格转移正规化. Rombach等人(2022年);Podel等人(2024年)和空调适配器 Ye等人(2023年),风格转移日益成为有条件的一代任务,其中的中心挑战仍然是C-S分离王等人(2023年).

blocks.en: Existing methods can be broadly grouped into data-driven and training-free approaches. Data-driven methods learn style representations from paired or curated stylization data Ma et al. (2025) ; Gao et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025a) ; Qi et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2024) ; Sohn et al. (2023) ; Liu et al. (2023) , or train projection modules for C-S composition Xing et al. (2025) . These methods can be effective, but require additional training and are often constrained by the training distribution. Training-free methods instead manipulate pretrained VFM or diffusion features directly, including subtracting textual concepts from image embeddings Wang et al. (2024) , masking feature dimensions, shuffling spatial patches Zhu et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2025b) ; Ngweta et al. (2023) , modifying attention keys/values Roy et al. (2025) ; Chung et al. (2024) ; Hertz et al. (2024) ; He et al. (2026) , or adjusting the reverse diffusion trajectory through inversion or test-time optimization Zhang et al. (2023b) ; Hertz et al. (2024) ; Rout et al. (2025) ; Zhou et al. (2025) . Though effective, these methods often face a leakage-degradation dilemma across the style-transfer pipeline: feature operations may leave residual content or remove useful style cues, single-space representations are fragile across VFMs, and style conditions drift during diffusion sampling. Based on this analysis, CLeaR combines Orthogonal Subspace Projection, Ensemble Inversion, and Energy-Guided Calibration to form a unified solution for content-leakage-resistant style transfer.
blocks.zh: 现有方法可广泛分为数据驱动方法和无培训方法。 数据驱动方法从配对或编配的阶梯化数据Ma等人(2025年);Gao等人(2025年);Wang等人(2025a年); Qi等人(2024年);Zhang等人(2024年);Sohn等人(2023年);Liu等人(2023年),或C-S组成Xing等人(2025年)的列车投影模块. 这些方法可以有效,但需要更多的培训,而且往往受到培训分配的限制。 无训练方法直接操控预先训练的VFM或扩散特性,包括从图像嵌入中减去文字概念 Wang等人(2024年),遮掩特征维度,洗刷空间补丁Zhu等人(2025年),Wang等人(2025年b),Ngweta等人(2023年),修改注意键/值Roy等人(2025年),Chung等人(2024年),Hertz等人(2024年),He等人(2026年),或通过反向或试验时间优化张等人(2023年b),Hertz等人(2024年),Rout等人(2025年),周等人(2025年),调整反向扩散轨迹. 这些方法虽然有效,但往往在风格转移管道中面临渗漏-降解困境:特征操作可能留下剩余内容或去除有用的风格提示,单空间表现在VFM之间很脆弱,在扩散取样时风格条件漂移. 基于这一分析,CLeaR结合了Orthogonal Subspace Projection,Ensemble Inversion,和Energy-Guided 校准,形成了一个统一的解决方案,用于内容-leakage-抗辐射风格的传输.

blocks.en: Model inversion (MI) techniques originally emerged to analyze privacy risks by reconstructing training data from machine learning models Fredrikson et al. (2014) ; Fredrikson et al. (2015) . Early MI approaches primarily target classification networks, using gradient-based optimization and generative priors to reconstruct the original inputs from deep representations Zhang et al. (2020) ; Kahla et al. (2022) ; Struppek et al. (2022) . While traditional methods are generally tailored for classifiers, recent advancements Chen et al. (2025) have extended inversion paradigms to extract high-dimensional visual information from complex, large-scale VFMs successfully.
blocks.zh: 模型反演(MI)技术最初通过从机器学习模型弗雷德里克森等人(2014年)重建培训数据来分析隐私风险;弗雷德里克森等人(2015年). 早期管理办法主要针对分类网络,利用梯度优化和基因前科重建深层表述的原始投入 Zhang等人(2020年);Kahla等人(2022年);Struppek等人(2022年)。 虽然传统方法一般适合分类者,但最近的进展 陈等. (2025)扩展了反演范式,从复杂,大规模VFM中成功提取高维视觉信息.

blocks.en: These inversion techniques provide a natural bridge between feature spaces and the pixel domain. And in our C-S separation process, the image pixel space serves as a universal grounding domain that corresponds to all VFM feature spaces. Leveraging this insight, we employ model inversion to combine heterogeneous representations.
blocks.zh: 这些反向技术为特征空间和像素域提供了自然的桥梁. 而在我们的C-S分离过程中,图像像素空间充当一个与所有VFM特征空间对应的通用地面域. 利用这种洞察力,我们采用模型反演,将各种表述结合起来。

blocks.en: CLeaR contains three components that correspond to the three failure sources discussed in Sec. 1 . Orthogonal Subspace Projection defines a content-reduced style target in each VFM feature space. Ensemble Inversion combines these model-specific targets by optimizing a shared pixel-space style anchor. Energy-Guided Calibration then keeps the generated image aligned with the target style during diffusion sampling. The overall pipeline is summarized in Fig. 1 and Appendix A .

Assumption 1 is motivated by two standard ideas.
First, heterogeneous vision encoders can provide complementary feature views rather than identical errors, making cross-model dependence, rather than exact equality, the key quantity to control.
Second, local recovery in inverse problems is typically tied to a nondegenerate Jacobian or sensitivity matrix.
These perspectives are consistent with recent evidence on complementary encoder biases and ensemble diversity, as well as standard identifiability analyses in inverse problems Kar et al. (2024) ; Wood et al. (2023) ; Rouchier (2018) ; Cintrón-Arias et al. (2020) .

blocks.en: Fig. 3 shows the qualitative comparisons, with magenta boxes marking content leakage and cyan boxes marking style degradation. Existing methods often fail on one side of the leakage-degradation dilemma: data-driven methods such as StyleShot, DEADiff, and CSGO show limited style alignment on out-of-distribution references; feature-manipulation methods such as InstantStyle and MaskST either retain residual content or suppress style details; and trajectory-level methods such as RB-Modulation and StyleAligned can depend on unavailable style-name priors. Attention Distillation preserves texture but often introduces reference content. In contrast, CLeaR achieves stronger style transfer with less visible content leakage. More results are in Appendix C .

blocks.en: Tab. 1 reports the quantitative comparison. CLeaR achieves the best performance on most metrics, with clear gains in the two key aspects of C-S disentanglement: style alignment and content leakage suppression. Compared with the strongest baseline, CLeaR improves CSD by 8.3%, Style Loss by 64.9%, DINO by 60.7%, KID by 51.1%, and AI-Scoring by 8.05%, while maintaining competitive content alignment with the second-best CLIP score. Its slightly lower aesthetic score may result from the inversion process, which prioritizes disentanglement and structural preservation over aesthetic smoothing. We further validate these conclusions in Appendix E using held-out VFMs and AI evaluators, which show consistent trends and confirm that the reported gains are not biased by the closed-loop evaluation setup.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented CLeaR, a training-free framework for content-leakage-resistant style transfer. We identified that the leakage-degradation dilemma arises across the entire style transfer process: from separating C-S features, to grounding the style signal in a representation space, to injecting it during diffusion generation. CLeaR addresses these three sources with Orthogonal Subspace Projection for content-reduced style targets, Ensemble Inversion for multi-VFM style anchor extraction, and Energy-Guided Calibration for style-preserving diffusion sampling. Our theoretical analysis supports the benefit of using multiple VFMs, and experiments on StyleBench show improved style alignment and content leakage suppression. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of addressing C-S disentanglement jointly across feature separation, style representation, and generation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了CLeaR,一个无培训的框架,用于内容不漏的风格转移. 我们发现,渗漏-降解困境出现在整个风格转移过程中:从分离C-S特征到将风格信号放置在代表空间,到在扩散生成过程中注入. CLeaR用Orthogonal Subspace Projection处理这三种源,用于内容减少的样式目标,Ensemble Inversion用于多VFM样式主锚提取,以及Energy-Guided校正用于样式保存扩散取样. 我们的理论分析支持使用多种VFM的好处,关于Style Bench的实验显示,风格一致和内容泄漏抑制得到了改进. 这些结果表明,在特征分离、风格代表性和代际之间共同解决C-S分离问题是有效的。

blocks.en: Despite its effectiveness, CLeaR has several limitations. First, it introduces additional test-time computation via Ensemble Inversion and Energy-Guided Calibration. While the measured runtime is comparable to several training-free baselines, it is still slower than simpler feed-forward methods. Second, as analyzed in Appendix G , ambiguous content descriptions, degenerate anchors, and adapter misinterpretation of inversion noise can still lead to leakage and artifacts. These cases represent an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 尽管CLeaR具有有效性,但有若干局限性. 首先,它通过Ensemble Inversion和Energy-Guided校准引入了额外的测试时间计算. 虽然所测量的运行时间可与若干无培训基线相比,但仍比较简单的进料法慢。 第二,如附录G所分析的,内容描述含糊不清,锚变质,适配器对反向噪声的误解仍然可能导致泄漏和文物. 这些案件是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en: Appendix E Comparisons on Held-Out VFMs and AI Evaluator
blocks.zh: 附录E 关于被搁置的VFM和AI评价器的比较

blocks.en: Table A1: Performance of held-out VFMs and independent AI evaluators, with the best and second-best scores marked accordingly.
blocks.zh: 表A1:被搁置的VFM和独立的AI评价员的表现,最佳和次佳的分数也相应标出.

blocks.en: To address the concern that CLeaR optimizes and evaluates on overlapping VFM features (CSD-CLIP, VGG, DINO) and that Qwen3 is used both for content description generation and AI-based evaluation, we conduct additional experiments with held-out VFMs and independent AI evaluators. We add SigLIP Tschannen et al. (2025) and Nomic Nussbaum et al. (2024) as additional VFMs. Since our original selection (e.g., CLIP, DINO, CSD-CLIP) already covers the most standard models for style transfer and vision-language representation, few suitable alternatives remain. For AI evaluation, we include Kimi-K2.6 Team et al. (2025) and GPT-5.5 OpenAI (2026) . To ensure comprehensive coverage, we evaluate these new metrics across all four aspects.
blocks.zh: 为了解决CLeaR优化和评价重叠的VFM特性(CSD-CLIP,VGG,DINO)以及Qune3既用于内容描述生成,也用于基于AI的评价的担忧,我们与被搁置的VFMs和独立AI评价员进行了更多的实验. 我们增加了SigLIP Tschannn等人(2025年)和Nomic Nussbaum等人(2024年)作为额外的VFM. 由于我们最初的选择(例如CLIP,DINO,CSD-CLIP)已经涵盖了风格转移和视觉语言代表的最标准模式,所以剩下的合适的替代品很少. 关于AI评价,我们包括Kimi-K2.6 Team等人(2025)和GPT-5.5 OpenAI(2026). 为了确保全面覆盖,我们评估这些新的衡量标准涉及所有四个方面。

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. A1 , CLeaR consistently achieves the best or competitive performance across all held-out VFMs and independent AI evaluators. These results confirm that our improvements generalize beyond the models used during optimization and are not biased by the closed-loop evaluation setup.
blocks.zh: 如塔布所示. A1, CLeaR在所有持有的VFM和独立的AI评价人员中一贯取得最佳或有竞争力的业绩. 这些结果证实,我们的改进超越了优化期间使用的模型,没有受到闭路评价设置的偏见。

blocks.en: Appendix F Ablation on Style Categories
blocks.zh: 附录F 对样式类别的影响

blocks.en: To investigate performance variation across different styles, we compute SA and CL scores for all 73 style types in StyleBench.
blocks.zh: 为了调查不同风格的性能变化,我们计算Style Bench中所有73种风格的SA和CL分数.

blocks.en: As seen in Tab. A2 , styles whose stylistic identity is carried by rendering rather than subject matter (e.g., Impressionism, Watercolor, Line Art, and Primitivism) achieve high scores on both SA and CL, indicating easier C-S disentanglement when stylistic signals are distributed across the entire image. In contrast, styles associated with religious, mythological, or historical subjects (e.g., Classicism, Rococo, and Baroque) exhibit lower CL scores even when SA remains high. Such themes often involve complex figures, narratives, or symbols that are hard to enumerate in c c , making C-S disentanglement more challenging during Ensemble Inversion.
blocks.zh: 如塔布所见. A2,其风格特征通过渲染而不是主题物(如印象主义,水彩,线条艺术,和Primitivism)在SA和CL上都取得了很高的分数,表明当结构信号分布在整个图像上时,C-S的分解更容易. 相比之下,与宗教,神话,或历史主题相关的风格(如经典主义,Rococo,和Baroque)即使在SA保持高位时也表现出较低的CL分数. 这类主题往往涉及复杂数字,叙事,或符号,在cc 中难以列举,使得C-S的解析在"Ensemble Inversion"期间更具挑战性.

blocks.zh: 表A2:样式奔驰73个类别的细目。 富有的纹理风格产生高SA和CL,而以主题为中心的风格则显示低CL,尽管强烈的SA.

blocks.en: Appendix G Analysis on Failure Modes
blocks.zh: 附录G 失败模式分析

blocks.en: We analyze three representative failure modes of CLeaR. All stem from limitations in current pretrained modules rather than the disentanglement formulation itself.
blocks.zh: 我们分析了CLeaR的三个代表性失败模式. 其原因都在于目前预先训练的模块的局限性,而不是分散式配方本身。

blocks.en: In theory, an ideal c c allows OSP to remove all content-related components. However, as discussed in Appendix F , certain styles are difficult to describe clearly, leading to residual content leakage.
blocks.zh: 在理论上,理想的cc允许OSP去除所有与内容相关的组件. 然而,如附录F所述,某些风格难以清晰描述,导致剩余内容渗漏。

blocks.en: Fig. A3 shows cases where Ensemble Inversion produces a degenerate anchor that either contains almost no information (col 2) or replicates the style reference (cols 1, 3, 4). This failure mode is frequently observed in styles such as Line Art, Stick Figure, and Icon. Although orthogonal projection is designed to remove content from the style target, current VFM embeddings do not always provide a direction that separates style from content. When style is tightly coupled with a specific object, the inversion objective is satisfied either by an anchor without meaningful structure or by one that copies the reference.
blocks.zh: 图. A3 显示了Ensemble Inversion生成一个变质主播的情况,该主播要么几乎没有信息(第2栏),要么复制样式引用(第1,3,4栏). 这种失败模式在线条艺术,棒图,图标等样式中经常被观察到. 虽然正交投影设计是为了从样式目标中去除内容,但目前的VFM嵌入并不总是提供一个将样式与内容分开的方向. 当风格与特定对象紧密结合时,反向目标要么由没有有意义的结构的锚或复制引用的锚满足.

blocks.en: Figure A3: Degenerate style anchors. Ensemble Inversion may produce an anchor with no structure or one that copies the reference, especially when content and style are tightly coupled.
blocks.zh: 图A3:脱源风格主播. 集成反演可能会产生一个没有结构或复制参考物的锚,特别是当内容和风格紧密结合时.

blocks.en: Fig. A4 shows another failure mode that arises when the style anchor I a ∗ I_{a}^{*} is used as the image condition for diffusion generation, where the output contains noisy lines and blobs. As discussed in Sec. 3.3 , the inverted anchor lies outside the adapter’s training distribution, so the adapter may misinterpret noise in the anchor as semantic content, forming artifacts in the final result.
blocks.zh: 图片. A4 显示另一种失败模式, 当样式主锚 I a + I_{a}^{*} 用作扩散生成的图像条件时, 输出包含吵吵的行和blobs 。 如第3.3节所述,反向锚位于适配器的训练分布之外,适配器可能会将锚中的噪声误解为语义内容,最终形成文物.

blocks.en: Figure A4: Artifacts in the generation stage. The adapter may misinterpret inversion noise in style anchor as semantic content, producing noisy lines and blobs.
blocks.zh: 图A4:生成阶段的艺术品. 适配器可能会将风格锚中的反向噪声误解为语义内容,产生吵吵的线条和blobs.
